custom_filters.description: List of custom filter definitions; each entry maps a name to a search query string (see API Search API docs). Format: [{name: '<filter_name>', query: '<search_string>'}, ...]. Valid names must be lowercase identifiers, e.g., 'my_hosts', 'web_servers'. Queries use Foreman's search syntax (field = value AND ...).

password.description: Foreman password (required unless FOREMAN_PASSWORD environment variable is set)

server.description: Foreman server URL (required unless FOREMAN_SERVER environment variable is set)

user.description: Foreman username (required unless FOREMAN_USER environment variable is set)
